message: Preregistered a single exploratory reference-recipe repair after proving the prior 64-frame reward-biased sampler was inert. No fresh records or GPU updates have started.
Frozen the tested CR-DYN-0010 implementation before remote execution. The implementation commit passed 158 tests, ledger validation, all CoinRun shell syntax checks and git diff checks.

Exactly one same-instance start request in this agent cycle returned to Failed because A10 sales were temporarily suspended in the zone. No remote preflight, data collection or training started. The Codex heartbeat now retries only the same instance idempotently.

GitHub lightweight CI reproduced an eager optional Grain import in dreamer.dynamics_validation. A precise subprocess test was red, commit 2fbfe81 made the dataloader import lazy, and the exact CI dependency set passed 159 tests plus compile and shell checks. No data or GPU work had started; the frozen scientific protocol and runner digest are unchanged.

The same A10 returned to Running. Detached HEAD, clean status, runner digest, action evaluator, Hydra overrides and every checkpoint passed preflight. The rejected continuous demo was stopped only after preflight and archived. Exactly one CR-DYN-0010 pipeline started and entered fresh 160-frame train collection.

Fresh final-policy collection and all three data audits completed: 4,096 train and 512 held-out episode-safe 160-frame records passed split, pair and action-contract checks. Reward-biased sampling is now operational with 97 legal 64-frame starts and 33 legal 128-frame starts. The live pipeline advanced to reevaluating the rejected medium baseline on these fixed futures.

The rejected medium baseline finished fixed-future shortcut and action-corruption evaluation before the repair run. It scored 18.402460 dB mean-frame PSNR, 0.720044 mean SSIM and 18.402460 dB at horizon 16. On the 64-video action subset, aligned actions exceeded shuffled and all-noop controls by 2.776499 and 2.640131 dB at horizon 16. These baseline diagnostics do not override the prior direct visual rejection. Latent statistics were recomputed from 256 fresh 128-frame videos, and the single 200,000-update medium repair training started from scratch.
